configurations.name: design-web
runtimeArgs: import functools, http.server as h; h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.extensions_map['.html'] = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'; h.test(HandlerClass=functools.partial(h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory='design'), port=8778, bind='127.0.0.1')
